title: Scalar extension and compactly supported exchange
statement: For a cartesian square of separated finite-type compactifiable morphisms between Noetherian schemes and a finite commutative coefficient map A→B, compact-support scalar comparison commutes with the exact inverse-image compact-support exchange. The input M and its scalar extension are bounded below. Use the chosen compactifications and the normalized scalar/pullback and compact-support maps of [def-per-exceptional-coefficient-maps] and [lem-pur-etale-compact-scalar-coherence].

source.place: Compatibility (3), Scalar extension and compactly supported exchange

proof.text: Expand exchange on a compactification into proper exchange followed by inverse open exchange. The proper scalar square and the open scalar square paste by naturality, giving the square for the pulled-back compactification.

Exact inverse image preserves both lower bounds. The scalar/pullback isomorphism supplies the scalar bound after pullback. Apply scalar refinement coherence to transfer the result to the chosen compactification.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility (3), tensor and mixed Cartesian squares.

theorem etaleCompactScalarBaseChange
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian X'] [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian Y']
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {h : X' ⟶ X}
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated f'] [LocallyOfFiniteType f'] [QuasiCompact f']
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification f']
    (sq : IsPullback h f' f g)
    (M : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (hQM : ∃ N : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)),
      N.obj = (scalarExtension φ X).obj M.obj) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) g).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((compactScalarChosenMap φ f).app M.obj) ≫
      (unboundedEtaleCompactSupportBaseChange B sq).app ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M.obj) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f').map
        ((properOpenCoefficientPullbackIso φ h).hom.app M.obj) =
      (properOpenCoefficientPullbackIso φ g).hom.app
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj M.obj) ≫
      (scalarExtension φ Y').map ((unboundedEtaleCompactSupportBaseChange A sq).app M.obj) ≫
      (compactScalarChosenMap φ f').app
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).mapDerivedCategory.obj M.obj)
